findings.label: Alerts card total counts SECURITY items that render no detail
findings.detail: computeAlertSummary sets total: raw.length, so merged Defender SECURITY items raise the alert total even though the anomaly TopList only plots ANOMALY rows with usage > 0. Consistent with the AWS/GCP shared route behavior and not a regression; noted so the headline number is understood as alerts+findings, not anomalies alone.

findings.label: AzureDashboardFindingsServiceTest uses reflection on private builders
findings.detail: The payload-discipline test invokes getAndSetOptimizationSummary / getAndSetSecurityPosture reflectively, so a future rename of those private methods breaks the test at runtime rather than compile time. Maintenance note, not a defect; the assertions pin the correct absence-vs-false-zero behavior.
